label: Pool play
text: Round robin. Everyone plays every other player once, one game each.

label: Pool standings
text: Wins, then fewest losses, then head-to-head result.

label: Playoffs
text: All five players advance, seeded by pool play standings. Every series is best of 3.

label: Semifinals
text: Seed 1 vs the play-in winner, and seed 2 vs seed 3.

label: Game 1
text: The higher seed picks the map.

label: Game 2
text: The lower seed picks the map.
